global_rules: A role registry never grants work-package authority.
Child-agent authority is a subset of parent authority.
High/critical work cannot be self-certified by the implementation-authoring authority path.
AI-authored prose is not machine evidence by itself.
Hidden chain-of-thought is not project evidence.
